⚡ EnergyManager

Manage a power grid: balance electricity generation (solar, wind, coal) against consumption across a city. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Monitor power generation from all sources.
  2. Match generation to consumption — the grid must be balanced.
  3. Use renewable sources (solar, wind) when available to save costs.
  4. React to spikes in demand — a sudden surge can overload the grid.
  5. Plan for peak demand times — build enough capacity.
